result.summary: This is a residential intersection featuring row houses and a faded zebra-style crosswalk across a side street. The environment lacks modern pedestrian safety features such as ADA-compliant curb ramps, high-visibility signage, or daylighting at the corners.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The zebra markings across the side street are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center right, crossing the side street

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles, specifically the white SUV, are positioned very close to the intersection, blocking the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: There are no visible sloped transitions from the sidewalk to the roadway, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: This residential street features a sidewalk on the left side but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming infrastructure. The presence of parked vehicles and relatively wide travel lanes may lead to visibility issues and higher vehicle speeds in a residential context.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked crossing points for pedestrians along this stretch of road.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb can block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven road surfaces could pose a hazard for cyclists or pedestrians in the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to provide designated and visible crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.
